validationRules: Exactly 1 active Titan for normal campaign, elite, ascension, raid, weekly trial, and async challenge attack modes
No additional allied player Titans may occupy the battlefield in normal combat
Owned Titan collection remains valid; mission selection chooses the best single Titan
Future reserve data may be stored but only one Titan appears at a time
Equipment and ability snapshots must reference valid owned active Titan state
